papers.title: Semantic and Visual Evidence for Efficient Long-Video Reasoning: A Solution for the HD-EPIC VQA Challenge
papers.authors: Yinsong Xu, Wei Jing, Liuxin Zhang, Wanjun Lv, Hui Li
papers.tags: video search, object detection, multimodal learning, video segmentation
papers.intro: 本文提出一个两阶段证据引导框架，通过离线构建可复用的语义证据（结构化文本）和视觉证据（对象级边界框与视觉嵌入），并在在线推理时进行查询条件化的证据检索与整合，从而高效解决长时程第一视角视频问答问题，在HD-EPIC VQA挑战中取得65.8%的整体准确率，显著超越所有基线方法。

papers.title: G3T Up! Gravity Aligned Coordinate Frames Simplify Pointmap Processing
papers.authors: Bharath Raj Nagoor Kani, Noah Snavely
papers.tags: 3D reconstruction, point cloud, pose estimation, depth estimation
papers.intro: 本文提出重力接地几何变换器（G3T），通过将点图预测从相机中心框架迁移到重力对齐的直立框架，利用强结构先验减少旋转自由度，并进一步设计G3T-Long子图增量重建管道，显著提升3D重建精度和鲁棒性。

papers.title: LocateAnything: Fast and High-Quality Vision-Language Grounding with Parallel Box Decoding
papers.authors: Shihao Wang, Shilong Liu, Yuanguo Kuang, Xinyu Wei, Yangzhou Liu, Zhiqi Li, Yunze Man, Guo Chen, Andrew Tao, Guilin Liu, Jan Kautz, Lei Zhang, Zhiding Yu
papers.tags: visual grounding, object detection, multimodal learning, vision transformer
papers.affiliations: NVIDIA (主要), The Hong Kong Polytechnic University, Princeton University, Nanjing University, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
papers.intro: 提出LocateAnything，通过并行框解码（Parallel Box Decoding, PBD）将每个边界框作为原子单元一步平行预测，在保持结构一致性的同时显著提升解码吞吐量和定位质量。

papers.title: Feedforward 3D Editing Learns from Semantic-Part Transformation
papers.authors: Jiawei Weng, Saining Zhang, Zhenxin Diao, Peishuo Li, Henghaofan Zhang, Junhao Chen, Hao Zhao
papers.tags: diffusion model, 3D reconstruction, scene understanding, multimodal learning
papers.intro: 本文提出通过语义部分变换来构建大规模高质量3D编辑配对数据集Pxform，并在此基础上设计了前馈编辑网络PartFlow，实现了无需推理时3D掩码的几何和外观通用3D编辑。

papers.title: When Eyes Betray AI: Social Gaze Consistency as a Semantic Cue for AI-Generated Image Detection
papers.authors: Kim Jihyeon, Sohee Kim, Soosan Lee, Souhwan Jung, James Matthew Rehg, Hyesong Choi
papers.tags: image classification, image generation, diffusion model, CLIP
papers.affiliations: Kim Jihyeon - School of Computer Engineering, Hoseo University Sohee Kim - School of Electronic Engineering, Soongsil University Soosan Lee - School of Electronic Engineering, Soongsil University Souhwan Jung - School of Electronic Engineering, Soongsil University James Matthew Rehg - School of Comp
papers.intro: 本文提出社交注视一致性（两个人之间凝视方向、头-眼对齐、瞳孔放置的联合几何一致性）作为高层语义检测线索，通过配对编辑数据集（仅眼区局部修复）和块组合描述监督（固定推理骨架+表面多样性），在多个检测器上显著提升对生成图像的部分编辑伪造的检测精度，并揭示该线索与骨干网络无关、可跨生成器迁移。

papers.title: Towards Controllable Image Generation through Representation-Conditioned Diffusion Models
papers.authors: Nithesh Chandher Karthikeyan, Jonas Unger, Gabriel Eilertsen
papers.tags: image generation, diffusion model, vision transformer
papers.intro: 本文提出使用预训练自监督模型（DINO）的图像表示作为条件来训练潜在扩散模型（RCDM），通过在该表示空间中进行扰动、插值和语义方向发现，实现了无需标注数据的可控图像生成，并展示了表示空间的平滑性和一定解耦性。

papers.title: PARE: Pruning and Adaptive Routing for Efficient Video Generation
papers.authors: Yutong Wang, Yunke Wang, Tianfan Xue, Yu Qiao, Yaohui Wang, Xinyuan Chen, Chang Xu
papers.tags: video generation, diffusion model
papers.affiliations: The University of Sydney, Shanghai AI Laboratory, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
papers.intro: PARE通过结构感知的宽度剪枝（保护运动关键的时间注意力头）与内容自适应的块路由（根据去噪时间步和视觉内容动态选择要执行的块），联合压缩视频DiT的宽度和深度，在保持质量的同时大幅降低每步计算量，并能与步蒸馏进一步组合加速。

papers.title: EdgeFlow: Edge-Map Augmented VLM-Based Flowchart Processing for Industrial Requirements Engineering
papers.authors: Zhifei Dou, Shabnam Hassani, Ou Wei
papers.tags: scene understanding, image captioning
papers.intro: EdgeFlow通过将确定性Canny边缘图作为结构先验与原始图像同时输入VLM，在不需训练数据或微调的条件下，显著提升工业流程图到Mermaid代码转换的拓扑保真度（节点、边、路径三个层次均提升10个点以上）。

papers.title: Chartographer: Counterfactual Chart Generation for Evaluating Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Yifan Jiang, Dae Yon Hwang, Jesse C. Cresswell, Freda Shi
papers.tags: multimodal learning, visual question answering, image generation
papers.affiliations: University of Waterloo, Vector Institute, Layer 6 AI
papers.intro: 本文提出Chartographer框架，通过将图表逆向工程为可执行代码并生成种子控制的反事实图表变体，构建图表-问题家族，从而揭示VLMs在单一原始图表上正确回答但视觉证据变化后无法泛化的隐藏失败。

papers.title: How and What to Imagine? Visual Thinking in Unified Multimodal Models for Cross-View Spatial Reasoning
papers.authors: Qian Yang, Ankur Sikarwar, Huy Le, Le Zhang, Zhuan Shi, Perouz Taslakian, Aishwarya Agrawal
papers.tags: image generation, scene understanding, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: Mila - Québec AI Institute; Université de Montréal; McGill University; ServiceNow AI Research; Canada CIFAR AI Chair
papers.intro: 本文提出View Dropout（VDrop）训练干预，强制统一多模态模型（UMM）在跨视角空间推理中使用生成的思考图像，并通过可学性-信息性权衡框架比较了三种思考图像策略，发现全景视觉思考结合VDrop实现了最佳域外泛化。

papers.title: PlayClass: Automated Play Behaviour Classification in Poultry
papers.authors: Prince Ravi Leow, Neil Scheidwasser, Rebecca Oscarsson, Per Jensen, Samir Bhatt, David Alejandro Duchêne
papers.tags: object detection, tracking, Segment Anything, vision transformer, image classification
papers.affiliations: University of Copenhagen, Linköping University, Imperial College London
papers.intro: 本文提出PlayClass管道，结合SAM 3长视频跟踪（YOLO引导分块）和冻结视频/图像基础模型嵌入，在家禽顶视视频中实现个体级玩耍行为分类，其中V-JEPA 2.1结合手工运动特征在严重类不平衡数据集上达到77.0 macro F1。

papers.title: Rethinking Weakly-supervised Video Temporal Grounding From a Game Perspective
papers.authors: Xiang Fang, Zeyu Xiong, Wanlong Fang, Xiaoye Qu, Chen Chen, Jianfeng Dong, Keke Tang, Pan Zhou, Yu Cheng, Daizong Liu
papers.tags: multimodal learning, video segmentation, visual grounding, video search
papers.affiliations: 华中科技大学、中佛罗里达大学、浙江工商大学、广州大学、香港中文大学、北京大学
papers.intro: 本文首次从博弈论视角重新审视弱监督视频时间定位任务，将视频帧和查询词建模为博弈玩家，通过多元合作博弈理论学习帧-词间细粒度的不确定跨模态对应关系，从而无需时刻提案即可实现精确的时刻定位。

papers.title: EVIDENT: Routing MLLM Adaptation through Entity-Grounded Visual Evidence for Cross-Domain Video Temporal Grounding
papers.authors: Geo Ahn, Jiwook Han, Youngrae Kim, Joonseok Lee, Jinwoo Choi
papers.tags: video search, multimodal learning, video segmentation, tracking
papers.affiliations: Kyung Hee University, University of Southern California, Seoul National University
papers.intro: 本文提出EVIDENT框架，通过实体瓶颈适配器、实体绑定蒸馏和实体到证据门控机制，将VTG微调锚定在预训练MLLM固有的实体注意力能力上，以实体级视觉证据驱动时间定位，从而显著提升跨域鲁棒性。

papers.title: STORM: Internalized Modeling for Spatial-Temporal Reasoning in Video-Language Models
papers.authors: Yiming Liang, Yixiao Chen, Yiyang Zhou, Yixuan Wang, Shoubin Yu, Andong Deng, Fuxiao Liu, Qin Zhang, Chen Chen, Mohit Bansal, Huaxiu Yao
papers.tags: video search
papers.affiliations: Purdue University, Harvard University, University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill, University of Central Florida, NVIDIA, Physion Labs（按作者脚注顺序）
papers.intro: STORM提出了一种两阶段训练框架，通过训练阶段用生成的思想视频对潜在token进行动态监督，并在推理阶段仅通过有界潜轨迹进行内部化时空推理，从而在不使用外部工具也不显式生成中间视频的情况下提升视频推理准确率并大幅降低推理开销。

papers.title: TempRet: Temporal Enhancement and Two-Stage Reranking for CVPR 2026 EPIC-KITCHENS-100 Multi-Instance Retrieval Challenge
papers.authors: Zixu Li, Yupeng Hu, Zhiwei Chen, Zhiheng Fu, Xiaowei Zhu, Weili Guan, Liqiang Nie
papers.tags: video search
papers.affiliations: Shandong University; Harbin Institute of Technology (Shenzhen)
papers.intro: TempRet是一个面向EPIC-KITCHENS-100多实例检索的CLIP基双编码器系统，通过在视频端引入时间Transformer并在推理时使用两阶段重排序（双编码器粗检索+交叉编码器ITM精细重排），结合对软标签感知的对称多相似性损失，在V2T和T2V双方向取得了领先的平均mAP与nDCG。

papers.title: Geo-Align: Video Generation Alignment via Metric Geometry Reward
papers.authors: Zizun Li, Haoyu Guo, Runzhe Teng, Chunhua Shen, Tong He
papers.tags: video generation, diffusion model, 3D reconstruction
papers.affiliations: USTC（中国科学技术大学）、Shanghai AI Lab（上海人工智能实验室）、ZJU（浙江大学）
papers.intro: 本文提出Geo-Align，第一个针对相机控制视频重渲染的强化学习框架，通过可验证的度量几何奖励（旋转与平移误差）和审美奖励，结合跨域数据融合策略与Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO），在不依赖配对多视角数据的情况下显著提升了轨迹跟随精度和视觉质量。

papers.title: PiD: Fast and High-Resolution Latent Decoding with Pixel Diffusion
papers.authors: Yifan Lu, Qi Wu, Jay Zhangjie Wu, Zian Wang, Huan Ling, Sanja Fidler, Xuanchi Ren
papers.tags: image generation
papers.intro: PiD通过在像素空间进行条件扩散，将潜在解码与高分辨率上采样统一为单个生成模块，利用噪声感知适配器和DMD2蒸馏实现快速、高质量、高分辨率的潜在解码。

papers.title: ETCHR: Editing To Clarify and Harness Reasoning
papers.authors: Beichen Zhang, Yuhong Liu, Jinsong Li, Yuhang Zang, Jiaqi Wang, Dahua Lin
papers.tags: image generation, object detection, diffusion model
papers.affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shanghai AI Laboratory, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Shanghai Innovation Institute, CPII under InnoHK
papers.intro: 本文提出ETCHR，一种将专用图像编辑模型与理解模型解耦、通过两阶段训练（推理模仿+推理增强）和编辑-验证-推理流程实现问题条件化、推理感知的图像编辑方法，显著提升了多种MLLM在细粒度感知、图表、逻辑、拼图和3D推理任务上的Pass@1指标。

papers.title: Good Token Hunting: A Hitchhiker's Guide to Token Selection for Visual Geometry Transformers
papers.authors: Shuhong Zheng, Michael Oechsle, Erik Sandström, Marie-Julie Rakotosaona, Federico Tombari, Igor Gilitschenski
papers.tags: 3D reconstruction, pose estimation, vision transformer, depth estimation
papers.affiliations: University of Toronto & Vector Institute（Shuhong Zheng, Igor Gilitschenski）；Google（Michael Oechsle, Erik Sandström, Marie-Julie Rakotosaona, Federico Tombari）；Technical University of Munich（Federico Tombari）
papers.intro: 本文提出GoToHunt，一种两阶段层次化token选择策略（帧间选择+帧内选择），在不需重新训练的情况下大幅加速视觉几何变换器，在500帧场景中实现超过85%的速度提升并保持甚至提升基线性能。

papers.title: Smart-Insertion-V: Photorealistic Video Insertion via a Closed-Loop Feedback Dual-Stream Framework
papers.authors: Xiao Cao, Yansong Qu, Xiangzhen, Chang, Wen Xiao, Jiakui Hu, Heyuan Li, Jialun Liu, Zhiyong Huang, Xuelong Li
papers.tags: diffusion model, video generation
papers.intro: 本文提出Smart-Insertion-V，一个基于闭循环反馈的双流框架，通过同步进行视频插入和图像风格迁移，并结合解耦引导模块和双视角Rotary Position Encoding，实现了无掩码的、风格和谐的参考物体视频插入。
